frameworks.name: id_effect
frameworks.scope: Published crates of the workspace at the scored tag; labs count under the labs cap (METHOD.md §3.2)

frameworks.name: Phoenix
frameworks.scope: Phoenix + standard Elixir stack (Ecto, Oban, Swoosh, LiveView)

frameworks.name: .NET
frameworks.scope: ASP.NET Core + EF Core + Aspire + Microsoft.Extensions

rows.name: Typed success / error / requirements
rows.measures: Errors and dependencies are tracked in the type of a program value; missing handling is a compile error.
rows.evidence: Effect<A,E=Never,R=HNil> is Send; typed HList R; compile-fail UI tests in crates/id_effect/tests/ui/.

rows.name: Typed dependency injection
rows.measures: Declaring, providing, overriding and scoping services, checked before run time.
rows.evidence: crates/id_effect/src/layer.rs (succeed/effect/scoped/merge/provide_to/fresh/launch), caps!/need::<K>(); tests layer*.rs.

rows.name: Composition ergonomics
rows.measures: How short and readable everyday sequential/parallel code is.
rows.evidence: effect! sequential binds, ~(a,b) parallel join; retry/repeat need factories; pipe helpers removed.

rows.name: Failure model (Cause / Exit)
rows.measures: Structured failure: expected errors, defects, interruption, composition and rendering.
rows.evidence: crates/id_effect/src/failure/{cause,exit}.rs; Die(Defect) keeps panic payload; tests/panic.rs.

rows.name: Resource safety (Scope / acquire-release)
rows.measures: Guaranteed release on success, failure and interruption; scoped lifetimes.
rows.evidence: kernel/resource.rs acquire_use_release/ensuring; finalizers run on interrupt; Layer::scoped.

rows.name: Interruption and cancellation
rows.measures: Cooperative cancellation, masking, propagation to children, finalizer semantics.
rows.evidence: uninterruptible/uninterruptible_mask/interruptible (kernel/resource.rs), parent interrupts children; tests/fibers.rs. No on_interrupt.

rows.name: timeout / race / zip-par combinators
rows.measures: First-class timeout, race, parallel zip/for-each with bounded concurrency.
rows.evidence: crates/id_effect/src/race.rs, par.rs; tests race_timeout.rs, par.rs. No race_with/disconnect.

rows.name: Lightweight fibers / processes
rows.measures: Cost and semantics of spawning, joining and supervising many concurrent tasks.
rows.evidence: Executor trait, real wakers; spawn_join_10k 6.67s → 17.2ms (docs/benchmarks/REPORT-0.7.md).

rows.name: Coordination primitives
rows.measures: Queue, PubSub, Deferred, Semaphore, Ref, Latch, channels; no panics on misuse.
rows.evidence: Waker-based constructors; coordination/channel.rs panic-free; streaming/channel.rs:306 still .expect; queue_bounded 2.55x slower than 0.6.

rows.name: Software transactional memory
rows.measures: Composable transactions over shared memory (TRef/TMap/TQueue) with retry/orElse.
rows.evidence: crates/id_effect_fp/src/stm/mod.rs parks on wakers; still in maintenance-tier fp crate.

rows.name: Parallel CPU compute
rows.measures: Built-in data-parallel / CPU-bound execution with admission control.
rows.evidence: crates/id_effect/src/compute/*; Concurrency::Inherit from Fabric.

rows.name: Raw performance and footprint
rows.measures: Throughput, latency and memory of typical workloads.
rows.evidence: axum_request_oneshot 52.5 → 7.16µs; schedule_retry_overhead 5.77x regression (REPORT-0.7.md).

rows.name: Language-level safety
rows.measures: Memory and data-race safety guaranteed by language and library policy.
rows.evidence: #![forbid(unsafe_code)] in every crate; no unsafe blocks in crates/ or labs/.

rows.name: Supervision trees
rows.measures: Restart strategies, intensity limits, dynamic children, shutdown policies.
rows.evidence: crates/id_effect_process/src/supervisor.rs (3 strategies, intensity, DynamicSupervisor); tests/coordination_supervisor.rs.

rows.name: Actor / process model
rows.measures: gen_server equivalent: mailboxes, call/cast/info, links, monitors, timers, selective receive.
rows.evidence: id_effect_process mailbox.rs, links/monitors/trap_exit. No selective receive, send_after or hibernate.

rows.name: State machines (gen_statem)
rows.measures: Typed FSMs with state data, timeouts, postpone, enter actions, visualisation.
rows.evidence: crates/id_effect_fsm (fieldless derive(Fsm), FsmProcess, Mermaid). No state timeouts/postpone/per-state data.

rows.name: Resilience patterns
rows.measures: Circuit breaker, retry, timeout, rate limit, bulkhead, hedging, fallback as composable policies.
rows.evidence: id_effect_resilience breaker/bulkhead/rate limiter; hedged is a race; core timeout. No fallback/policy pipeline.

rows.name: Retry / repeat schedule algebra
rows.measures: Composable schedules: exponential, jitter, fibonacci, union/intersect, cron.
rows.evidence: Typed Schedule<Out,In> (scheduling/schedule.rs) with fibonacci/union/intersect/jitter. No cron.

rows.name: Durable workflows and sagas
rows.measures: Persistent, resumable multi-step workflows with compensation.
rows.evidence: In-memory Saga in id_effect_fsm; labs/id_effect_workflow (sqlite, single writer), unpublished.

rows.name: Live reload and zero-downtime upgrades
rows.measures: Dev auto-reload and production upgrades without dropping work.
rows.evidence: Hot code loading is a non-goal (ADR 0009); HostDrain graceful drain only.

rows.name: Clustering and node membership
rows.measures: Node identity, discovery, failure detection, authenticated join.
rows.evidence: crates/id_effect_node (SWIM via foca, cookie HMAC, Static/DNS discovery, TCP/QUIC).

rows.name: Remote spawn / send / monitor
rows.measures: Location-transparent messaging, remote spawn, cross-node links/monitors.
rows.evidence: mesh.rs remote_spawn/call/cast/monitor; at-most-once delivery; node waits are effects.

rows.name: Singletons, groups and placement
rows.measures: Cluster singletons, process groups, global registry, sharding/placement.
rows.evidence: singleton.rs + PgAdvisoryLease, OrSwot groups, DistributedSupervisor. No global registry.

rows.name: Transport security
rows.measures: Encryption and mutual authentication between nodes.
rows.evidence: QUIC via rustls (accepts any cert); TCP authenticated but unencrypted.

rows.name: Schema / validation
rows.measures: Declarative decode/encode/validate with derive, refinements, error accumulation.
rows.evidence: crates/id_effect/src/schema (tuple/struct up to 12, Brand, Redacted, derive fixes).

rows.name: JSON Schema / OpenAPI generation
rows.measures: Generate JSON Schema and OpenAPI from the same schemas/routes the code uses.
rows.evidence: schema/json_schema_export.rs is primitive fragments only; SPEC.md: not implemented.

rows.name: SQL client, pooling, transactions
rows.measures: Typed rows/params, pooling, transactions, savepoints, isolation, streaming.
rows.evidence: id_effect_sql: tx roll back on defect/interrupt, scoped layers; rows are Vec<String> (MVP), few param types.

rows.name: ORM / query builder
rows.measures: Typed query construction, entity mapping, relations.
rows.evidence: None.

rows.name: Migrations
rows.measures: Versioned schema migrations with CLI, locking, up/down, CI check.
rows.evidence: Only an include_str! migration inside unpublished examples/http-showcase.

rows.name: Database backend breadth
rows.measures: Supported databases (Postgres, MySQL, SQLite, MSSQL, …) behind one API.
rows.evidence: Postgres only (feature pg via sqlx).

rows.name: Caching (local + distributed)
rows.measures: In-process and distributed caches, TTL, stampede protection, invalidation.
rows.evidence: resource/cache.rs capacity/ttl/typed failures; RequestCache + batching. No distributed cache.

rows.name: Event sourcing / CQRS
rows.measures: Event store, projections, command/query handlers, snapshots.
rows.evidence: labs/id_effect_events (unpublished).

rows.name: Persistent collections and FP toolkit

rows.evidence: id_effect_fp/optics maintenance tier; pipe/memoize/flip helpers removed in 0.7.

rows.name: HTTP server and routing
rows.measures: Routing, typed handlers, lifecycle, request scoping, graceful shutdown.
rows.evidence: id_effect_axum server_layer/serve*, fiber per request (panic → 500, disconnect → interrupt).

rows.name: Middleware pipeline
rows.measures: Composable request/response middleware with typed context.
rows.evidence: Tower feature of id_effect_axum, CapOverrideLayer, require_ready.

rows.name: Request validation
rows.measures: Schema-validated path/query/form/header/body extraction with uniform error bodies.
rows.evidence: decode_json_schema for JSON bodies only (id_effect_axum/src/json.rs).

rows.name: HTTP client

rows.name: Typed RPC / API contracts

rows.evidence: labs/id_effect_rpc (unpublished at 0.7).

rows.name: WebSockets and realtime

rows.evidence: No first-party support; raw axum only.

rows.name: GraphQL

rows.evidence: None.
